name: Suzuki Katana 600 / 750 (GSX600F / GSX750F)
engine: 600 or 748 cc oil-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: A comfy sport tourer. Gummed carbs are the usual reason one won't run right.

G: If it sat, clean the carbs fully. Gummed jets are the most common problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Carbs
known.what: Carburetor gumming and clogged jets cause rough idle and hesitation.
